newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH EMPLOYERS CALL FOR BAN ON SYMPATHY STRIKES.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH EMPLOYERS CALL FOR BAN ON SYMPATHY STRIKES.

text.p: Sympathy strikes to support demands in other sectors should be banned, the two leading employer lobbies said in a joint statement on Monday.
The Confederation of Finnish Industry and Employers (TT) and the Employers' Confederation of Service Industries said they had sent a petition on this to the government.
"Sympathy strikes which pursue collective bargaining issues in other sectors ... should be banned altogether," they said.
"True sympathy strikes and political labour market action should also be limited in the time to be brief, in case they cannot be prohibited completely," the federations said.
They also said the right to strike should take into consideration the relation between the benefits pursued and the social cost of striking action better than the current system does.
